title: Problem framing & domain understanding
description: Turn a domain question into a useful data science problem with a clear purpose and audience.

title: Data acquisition & preparation
description: Understand how data is gathered, represented, checked, and prepared for analysis.

title: Programming & computation
description: Use programming and computational tools to make analysis reproducible and practical.

title: Statistical foundations
description: Reason about variation, uncertainty, assumptions, and evidence.

title: Exploration & visualization
description: Explore patterns and represent data visually to support understanding.

title: Statistical modeling & inference
description: Build and assess statistical models, connecting results to the question being asked.

title: Machine learning & AI
description: Use learning methods to find patterns and make predictions while examining their limitations.

title: Causal reasoning & evaluation
description: Distinguish association from causation and reason about measurement and evaluation.

title: Ethics, equity & responsible AI
description: Consider who benefits, who may be harmed, and how data practices affect fairness and trust.

title: Communication & decision-making
description: Explain evidence clearly so people can make informed decisions.

title: Integration & real-world application
description: Bring foundations, methods, communication, and domain knowledge together in an applied project.
